<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919310_theRebbe_548" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919310_theRebbe_548__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">12 Tammuz 5738*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section introduces the verse and the Midrashic interpretations regarding in what to rejoice.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it."1</t>
    <t s="1">And the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe of the Geulah, brings in his maamar beginning with the words "Zeh"</t>
    <t s="2">[which he said at the celebration of the first 12 Tammuz</t>
    <t s="3">(at the thanksgiving meal),</t>
    <t s="4">in the year 56882],</t>
    <t s="5">that it is brought in the Midrash3,</t>
    <t s="6">Rabbi Avin said: We do not know in what to rejoice—whether in the day or in the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="7">Shlomo came and explained4</t>
    <t s="8">"Let us rejoice and be glad in You"—in the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="9">"In You"—in Your fear,</t>
    <t s="10">"In You"—in Your Torah,</t>
    <t s="11">"In You"—in Your salvation.5</t>
    <t s="12">Rabbi Yitzchak said: "In You"—in the twenty-two letters that You have written for us in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="13">"Beit" (ב) is two, "Chaf" (כ) is twenty,</t>
    <t s="14">thus "in You" (בך).</t>
    <t s="15">And the maamar clarifies,</t>
    <t s="16">What is the meaning of "We do not know in what to rejoice—whether in the day or in the Holy One, blessed be He"?</t>
    <t s="17">For since "This is the day that the Lord has made"</t>
    <t s="18">[meaning,</t>
    <t s="19">that even the virtue of the day is not from itself, but rather "this is the day that the Lord has made"],</t>
    <t s="20">it would seemingly be understood that the joy should be in the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">so what is the meaning of "We do not know in what to rejoice—whether in the day or in the Holy One, blessed be He"?</t>
    <t s="22">And also, what are the three matters of fear, Torah, and salvation?</t>
    <t s="23">And also, the statement of Rabbi Yitzchak, "In You"—in the twenty-two letters, etc., must be understood,</t>
    <t s="24">for "in You" simply means in the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="25">so why does he interpret "in You" as the twenty-two letters?</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the elevated nature of the day on which a miracle occurred.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the explanation of the virtue of the day</t>
    <t s="2">(to the extent that there is a possibility to think to rejoice in the day)</t>
    <t s="3">is6,</t>
    <t s="4">that the day on which a miracle occurred7</t>
    <t s="5">is a lofty day.</t>
    <t s="6">And there are two aspects to this.</t>
    <t s="7">For the day on which a miracle occurred is a meritorious day in its own right</t>
    <t s="8">(even beforehand),</t>
    <t s="9">therefore a miracle occurred on it,</t>
    <t s="10">for they bring merit through a meritorious day.8</t>
    <t s="11">And furthermore, through the miracle that occurred on it,</t>
    <t s="12">it becomes a meritorious day and an auspicious day, etc.</t>
    <t s="13">(even more so than it was beforehand).</t>
    <t s="14">Moreover, on this day itself, the primary elevation is in the specific time</t>
    <t s="15">(day or night)</t>
    <t s="16">in which the miracle occurred.</t>
    <t s="17">As it is brought in the Midrash9,</t>
    <t s="18">"When You perform miracles for us by day, we recite song before You by day</t>
    <t s="19">(And Devorah and Barak ben Avinoam sang on that day, etc.10),</t>
    <t s="20">and when You perform miracles for us by night, we recite song before You by night</t>
    <t s="21">(The song shall be for you as a night when a holy festival is observed11)."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
